Puts what to show and how it is shown back to the defaults.

This puts the collection, sources, picture quality, free-to-reuse choice, time per picture, picture order, picture fit, credits, credit size and Play without saving back to their defaults. Your saved pictures, favourites, blocked pictures, space limit, download setting and TV start time are not changed.
Version, privacy and where pictures come from.
Pictures come straight from NASA, ESA, ESO and NOIRLab to this TV and are saved only on this TV. There is no account, no tracking and no advertising.
Each picture\'s credit and licence details are saved with it and shown on screen. Cosmos\'s own code is MIT-licensed; the pictures are not, and belong to their credited owners under the terms shown.
